core.scope: Whole repository continuous-quality loop for Orchestra.
core.repoOverview: Orchestra is a Node >=22 / TypeScript strict daemon built on Effect. The CLI entry point is src/cli/main.ts, runDaemon wires Effect layers in src/cli/daemon.ts, the core orchestrator owns a single state fiber in src/core/orchestrator/loop.ts, adapters integrate GitHub Issues, Copilot CLI, and per-issue workspaces, and src/cockpit is a React 19 + Vite operator cockpit served by the daemon on loopback. Durable state lives under <workspace.root>/.orchestra/state.json at runtime. Config is WORKFLOW.md YAML front matter plus Liquid prompt body, decoded via Effect Schema. The repo has Vitest tests, Biome/Prettier lint, TypeScript checks, Vite/tsup build, React Doctor, and a checked-in .deepsec workspace.

inventory.userStory: As an operator, run orchestra against a WORKFLOW.md file and optionally expose the cockpit.
inventory.actualImplementedBehavior: runDaemon parses argv, loads workflow config, builds Effect layers, forks cockpit when --port is present, then runs the orchestrator.
inventory.expectedBehaviorFromCode: Invalid args/config fail through tagged errors; SIGINT/SIGTERM interrupt the Effect runtime and scoped fibers.
inventory.outputs: Logfmt events, orchestrator execution, optional cockpit server.
inventory.validationRules: Argument parser and workflow loader validate required path and typed config.
inventory.businessRules: Single daemon process owns the run.
inventory.edgeCases: Missing workflow file, invalid port, bind failure, invalid YAML/front matter, missing secrets.
inventory.dependencies: Effect runtime, Node platform, tsx/tsup build output.
inventory.runtimeRegistrationEvidence: package.json bin maps orchestra to dist/cli/main.js; src/cli/main.ts calls runDaemon.

inventory.featureName: Issue polling, selection, dispatch, retry, and reconciliation
inventory.userStory: As an operator, let the daemon schedule issue work with bounded concurrency and durable retry behavior.
inventory.actualImplementedBehavior: A single owner fiber drains messages, reconciles tracker state, preflights, selects candidates, dispatches workers, records running/retry/completed state, and applies backoff.
inventory.expectedBehaviorFromCode: Workers and retry timers only post messages; state mutation is serialized by the owner fiber.
inventory.inputs: Tracker issues, workflow config, worker outcomes, command bus messages.
inventory.outputs: Agent subprocesses, workspace operations, tracker reconciliation decisions, observer events, persisted state.
inventory.validationRules: Schema-validated issue/config/event data; active/terminal state normalization.
inventory.businessRules: Respect max concurrency, per-state concurrency, max turns, max failure retries, continuation delay, and budget/operator pause rules.
inventory.edgeCases: Tracker issue disappears, terminal state while running, orphaned state after restart, stalled run, exhausted retries, budget pause, operator pause, input-required continuation.
inventory.dependencies: IssueTracker, AgentRunner, WorkspaceManager, Clock, OrchestratorStore, Observer ports.
inventory.runtimeRegistrationEvidence: src/cli/daemon.ts provides appLayer; runOrchestrator is called from runDaemon.

inventory.featureName: Workflow loading, templating, settings hot reload, and secret resolution
inventory.userStory: As an operator, describe how issues are selected and prompted without leaking secrets.
inventory.actualImplementedBehavior: WORKFLOW.md front matter is decoded with defaults; Liquid body renders prompts; safe cockpit settings writes persist whitelisted raw config while preserving the Liquid body.
inventory.expectedBehaviorFromCode: Secrets are resolved from $VAR at load and never serialized through settings/state APIs.
inventory.outputs: WorkflowDefinition, prompt strings, persisted settings file updates.
inventory.validationRules: Effect Schema validates types/defaults and rejects non-whitelisted settings patches.
inventory.businessRules: Separate tracker and Copilot credentials; no resolved secrets in errors/API.
inventory.edgeCases: Missing env var, invalid YAML, invalid Liquid, unsafe settings key, whitespace token value, invalid concurrency/backoff values.
inventory.runtimeRegistrationEvidence: loadWorkflow is called by runDaemon; WorkflowFileLive is provided to cockpit handlers.
inventory.notes: WORKFLOW.md itself is gitignored operator config and not edited by this run.

inventory.userStory: As an operator, each issue should run in its own workspace with the agent cwd set to that workspace.
inventory.actualImplementedBehavior: WorkspaceManager computes sanitized per-issue paths, runs hooks, and gives the agent runner a workspace cwd.
inventory.expectedBehaviorFromCode: Safety invariant: the agent cwd is the issue workspace.
inventory.businessRules: Isolation is workspace-level, not OS sandboxing.
inventory.edgeCases: Path traversal, duplicate identifiers, hook failure, pre-existing workspace, missing root.
inventory.dependencies: Node filesystem and command executor through @effect/platform-node.

inventory.featureName: Copilot CLI runner and agent event normalization
inventory.userStory: As the daemon, run headless Copilot sessions and normalize streaming events.
inventory.actualImplementedBehavior: The adapter spawns Copilot with configured credentials/environment, maps JSONL events, and returns a worker outcome.
inventory.expectedBehaviorFromCode: Tracker token is not injected into the agent environment; Copilot credential is separate.
inventory.inputs: AgentRunParams, prompt, workspace cwd, optional resume session id.
inventory.outputs: AgentEvent stream, usage, outcome status, session id.
inventory.validationRules: Agent events decoded by schema/map logic.
inventory.businessRules: max_turns and retry policy are orchestrator-owned.
inventory.edgeCases: Malformed JSONL, process failure, timeout, input-required, stale resume session, missing copilot auth.
inventory.dependencies: GitHub Copilot CLI available in environment.

inventory.featureName: Loopback cockpit UI and command API
inventory.userStory: As an operator, inspect live fleet state and safely issue control commands from a local browser.
inventory.actualImplementedBehavior: Daemon serves SPA/static assets and typed HTTP API on 127.0.0.1 with security headers, loopback host guard, token injection, and command bus mutations.
inventory.expectedBehaviorFromCode: Read endpoints are loopback-only; mutating endpoints require bearer token and loopback origin/host.
inventory.inputs: Browser route, API request, bearer token, settings patch.
inventory.outputs: Rendered fleet/events/kanban/settings views, command acknowledgements, persisted whitelisted settings.
inventory.validationRules: Host loopback guard, CockpitAuth, settings schema/whitelist.
inventory.businessRules: Cockpit never mutates orchestrator state directly; all mutations flow through CommandBus.
inventory.edgeCases: Missing token, wrong origin/host, malformed settings patch, stale state polling, static asset 404, mobile/responsive layout.
inventory.runtimeRegistrationEvidence: runCockpit is forked by runDaemon when --port is supplied; Vite emits dist/cockpit for static serving.

inventory.featureName: Observability, snapshots, telemetry, and operator display state
inventory.userStory: As an operator, see accurate live state, events, completions, restore facts, budget status, and rate limits.
inventory.actualImplementedBehavior: Observer tee records recent activity while snapshot projection reads the authoritative store and display-only mirrors.
inventory.expectedBehaviorFromCode: Display state does not drive orchestration decisions except explicit command bus/operator pause inputs.
inventory.inputs: Orchestrator state, observer events, completion records, budget/control/restore services.
inventory.validationRules: Snapshot wire schema and test coverage.
inventory.businessRules: No secrets exposed in snapshots or logs.
inventory.edgeCases: Unknown event tags, large event rings, restart restore gap, no budget configured.
inventory.dependencies: Effect Logger/logfmt and optional OpenTelemetry packages.
inventory.runtimeRegistrationEvidence: ObservabilityLive and related live services are wired in appLayer.

inventory.journeyName: Operator starts daemon and agents process GitHub issues
inventory.businessGoal: Continuously move issue work through autonomous Copilot sessions.
inventory.exitPoint: Issues completed, retried, abandoned, or waiting for input according to configured rules.
inventory.expectedOutcome: Work proceeds within concurrency/retry/budget limits and state is durable.
inventory.alternatePaths: Continuation turns, retry backoff, operator pause, budget pause, restart restore.
inventory.failurePaths: Config error, tracker failure, workspace hook failure, Copilot failure, max failure retries reached.
inventory.edgeCases: SIGTERM, corrupted durable state, tracker terminal state mid-run, session resume stale.

inventory.journeyName: Operator monitors and controls fleet in cockpit
inventory.businessGoal: See current fleet state and apply safe dispatch/settings controls.
inventory.exitPoint: Read state or receive a command result from the daemon.
inventory.expectedOutcome: Read views render without credentials on loopback; mutations require token and go through CommandBus.
inventory.alternatePaths: Vite dev cockpit proxies /api/v1 to daemon; static production cockpit is served from dist/cockpit.
inventory.failurePaths: Forbidden host, unauthorized mutation, invalid settings patch, API/server unavailable.
inventory.edgeCases: Mobile layout, keyboard command palette, stale polling response, empty fleet, many events.

inventory.journeyName: Daemon restarts and restores durable state
inventory.businessGoal: Resume safe scheduling after process interruption.
inventory.exitPoint: Store restored, orphaned running work converted to continuation retries, and cockpit snapshot indicates restore.
inventory.expectedOutcome: Bookkeeping survives; unsafe in-flight work is re-derived through the normal retry path.
inventory.edgeCases: Retries due during downtime, completed issue while daemon down, resume_sessions enabled with stale Copilot session.

inventory.name: Cockpit HTTP API
inventory.authRequired: Mutations require bearer token plus loopback host/origin; reads require loopback host.
inventory.requestInputs: HTTP request, optional JSON settings/control payload, bearer token.
inventory.responseOutputs: Snapshot/settings/control result JSON or typed error.
inventory.validationRules: HttpApi schema, hostIsLoopbackHeader, CockpitAuth, settings whitelist.
inventory.retryTimeoutBehavior: Client polling handles repeated reads; command bus handles ack/failure.
inventory.rateLimitHandling: None; loopback-only trusted local operator surface.
inventory.securityConsiderations: DNS rebinding host guard, anti-framing/nosniff headers, bearer token for mutations, no secret serialization.
inventory.edgeCases: Non-loopback Host, missing Origin, invalid token, malformed JSON, command for unknown issue.

inventory.errorResponses: Tracker errors converted to tagged errors without secret payloads.
inventory.retryTimeoutBehavior: Poll loop skips dispatch on per-tick tracker failure; retry policy applies to agent outcomes.
inventory.rateLimitHandling: Rate limit data appears in snapshot if exposed by adapter/state.
inventory.securityConsiderations: Tracker token not passed to agent subprocess.
inventory.edgeCases: Rate limit, deleted issue, state label normalization, missing fields.

inventory.responseOutputs: Agent events, outcome, usage, session id.
inventory.validationRules: Event mapping and tagged outcome handling.

inventory.name: Cockpit token and dev server port
inventory.defaultValue: ORCHESTRA_COCKPIT_TOKEN absent generates a random token; ORCHESTRA_PORT defaults to 4317 for Vite proxy.
inventory.allowedValues: Trimmed non-empty token string; positive integer dev port.
inventory.behaviorWhenPresent: Token is logged/injected for cockpit mutations; Vite proxies to configured daemon port.
inventory.behaviorWhenMissing: Daemon generates token; Vite dev proxy uses 4317.
inventory.behaviorWhenInvalid: Whitespace token treated as absent; invalid port falls back.
inventory.runtimeRegistrationEvidence: runCockpit resolves token; vite.config.ts reads ORCHESTRA_PORT.

inventory.fieldsShape: Running/retrying/completed/abandoned state, totals, rate limits, restore/budget/control display fields, snapshot wire projection.

inventory.ruleName: Core I/O uses Effect and typed errors
inventory.ruleDescription: Everything that can fail, block, or touch I/O in core is modeled as Effect with tagged errors.
inventory.allowedConditions: Effect.sync/try/tryPromise at edges, Context.Tag ports, Layer wiring.
inventory.rejectedConditions: Bare async/Promise in src/core business logic.
inventory.edgeCases: Adapter edges may use tryPromise; tests use fakes/TestClock.
inventory.runtimeRegistrationEvidence: AGENTS.md and source imports enforce the project convention.

inventory.ruleDescription: Only the orchestrator owner fiber mutates orchestrator state; cockpit commands enter through CommandBus.
inventory.inputs: Worker outcomes, retry timers, cockpit commands.
inventory.allowedConditions: Messages posted to mailbox/command bus and processed by owner fiber.
inventory.rejectedConditions: Direct cockpit or worker mutation of state.
inventory.errorFailureBehavior: Command failures return typed command results.
inventory.edgeCases: Concurrent commands, worker completion during pause, retry timer while paused.
inventory.runtimeRegistrationEvidence: runCockpit receives CommandBus; no direct store mutation in cockpit handlers beyond command path.

inventory.ruleName: Secrets never serialize to public state, logs, errors, or agent env unintentionally
inventory.ruleDescription: Resolved tracker/Copilot/cockpit secrets are protected from serialization and accidental inheritance.
inventory.inputs: Env vars, config, cockpit token, child process env.
inventory.allowedConditions: Use references or generated process-local token; scrub child env.
inventory.rejectedConditions: Writing resolved tokens to WORKFLOW.md, snapshot, error payloads, or tracker-exposed agent env.
inventory.errorFailureBehavior: Secret missing/auth failures are reported without secret value.
inventory.clientSideEnforcement: Cockpit receives only cockpit mutation token, injected same-origin.
inventory.edgeCases: Whitespace token, malicious Host, invalid settings patch, ambient env inheritance.
inventory.runtimeRegistrationEvidence: README security model and tests cover token handling.

inventory.ruleDescription: Issue workspace paths are sanitized and contained under the configured workspace root.
inventory.rejectedConditions: Traversal or cwd outside issue workspace.
inventory.edgeCases: Unicode/symbol identifiers, duplicate sanitized names, absolute path input.

inventory.ruleName: Cockpit host, auth, and settings mutation guard
inventory.ruleDescription: Local cockpit requests must satisfy loopback host checks; mutations also require bearer auth and whitelisted payloads.
inventory.inputs: HTTP Host/Origin/Auth headers and settings patch.
inventory.allowedConditions: Loopback Host with valid token for mutations; whitelisted settings keys only.
inventory.rejectedConditions: Non-loopback Host, invalid token, unapproved config keys.
inventory.clientSideEnforcement: Cockpit API client sends injected token.
inventory.edgeCases: DNS rebinding, top-level navigation without Origin, missing token, invalid JSON.
inventory.runtimeRegistrationEvidence: runCockpit routes all API/static traffic through host guard.

risks.title: Agent subprocesses are intentionally unsandboxed
risks.descriptionEvidence: README Security & trust posture says agents run unsandboxed with --allow-all-tools; workspace and credentials are the intended v1 boundaries.
risks.impact: Operators must run the daemon in a low-privilege OS/container boundary when processing untrusted issues.
risks.mitigationPlan: Preserve the documented boundary and verify credential/workspace separation; do not mark as a repo defect unless code contradicts the documented v1 trust model.
risks.notes: Architecture decision, not a current defect.

assumptions.assumption: This run may edit repository-owned quality artifacts and code but must not edit gitignored WORKFLOW.md or protected tool directories unless explicitly required.
assumptions.basisEvidence: AGENTS.md says do not edit WORKFLOW.md, .impeccable/, .claude/, .deepsec/, or .cockpit-shots/.
assumptions.whatWouldInvalidate: User explicitly asks to modify one of those surfaces.

assumptions.assumption: Quality-autonomy parallel lanes are run serially in this session because the active multi-agent instruction forbids spawning sub-agents unless explicitly requested.

assumptions.whatWouldInvalidate: User explicitly authorizes sub-agents or parallel agent work.
